sources.marriott: marriott.com rate API (same data as the 'Select a Room and Rate' page), logged-in Chrome session
sources.hyatt: hyatt.com room-rate API (/shop/service/rooms/roomrates) and the search page, read through Safari on 2026-09-18 (Chrome was blocked by hyatt.com); not signed in. Cash totals are totalAfterTax (city tax included); points are the cheapest pure-points award for the whole stay.

definitions.cash_lowest: Cheapest cash rate for the whole stay, any rate type (often prepaid, non-refundable). total_eur includes all taxes and fees as priced by the site.
definitions.cash_lowest_refundable: Cheapest rate with free cancellation, whole stay, taxes and fees included.
definitions.points_lowest: Cheapest award for the whole stay. points_total covers all nights (Marriott's 5th-night-free is already applied when free_nights > 0); award_taxes_eur is cash still due on the award (mostly city tax).
definitions.status: available | no_availability (no cash or award rate for these dates) | sold_out (hyatt.com says the hotel is sold out) | opening_soon
definitions.room: Room names are cut to 30 characters by the scraper.
definitions.cash_with_codes: Lowest rate for each corporate code (Marriott 'Special rates' / cluster code), whole stay, taxes and fees included; null = the hotel returned no rate for that code. BYG = ByteDance Global Partner Rate, FSF = Meta Global Partner Rate, GGL = Google Rate. Corporate rates can require company ID at check-in.
definitions.cash_best: Cheapest of public and code rates; source says which one.
definitions.cash_best_refundable: Cheapest refundable of public and code rates.
definitions.points_options: Hyatt only: the cheapest award of each kind for the whole stay (standard room, suite, Points + Cash, upgrades). cash_eur is the cash part of a Points + Cash rate, null for pure points.
definitions.award_category: Hyatt only: World of Hyatt award category (null for Mr & Mrs Smith hotels).

accounts_2026_09_18.notes: Bilt figure is user-reported; Bilt transfers 1:1 to Hyatt and Marriott.
